summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Dubai International Exchange redesign. All 9 requested features tested. Found and fixed 1 critical bug (broken logo_color.svg). Backend API tests: 10/10 passed. Frontend tests: All features working correctly.
action_items: CRITICAL: The original logo_color.svg asset is broken - it references a local Windows file path (C:\Users\mouad\Downloads\...) instead of containing actual SVG content. A proper color logo SVG should be uploaded to replace it. Currently using logo_black.svg as workaround.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed broken logo_color.svg by using logo_black.svg for light mode in /app/frontend/src/config/assets.js
All new sections (CurrencyConverterSection, ContactSection, TermsPage) have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Currency converter correctly fetches rates from /api/rates/live/fetch endpoint
Section contrast is achieved through gradient backgrounds rather than solid colors
seed_data_creation: Default exchange rates seeded by backend (USD, EUR, GBP, TRY, AED, SAR, JOD, EGP)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 features tested and working: 1) Hero section with airplane and card-hand images, 2) CBI building in hero background, 3) Currency Converter with live/manual rates, 4) Contact section with form and social icons, 5) Terms page with accordion sections, 6) USDT section with new image, 7) Dark/Light mode toggle, 8) Section contrast (gradient backgrounds), 9) All CTA buttons working. Fixed broken logo_color.svg by using logo_black.svg.

hero_section_images.details: Airplane image and card-hand image displaying correctly in hero section

cbi_building_background.details: CBI building image visible in hero background with proper overlay

currency_converter.details: Converter loads rates from /api/rates/live/fetch, calculates conversions correctly (1000 USD = 1,460,000 IQD)

contact_section.details: Contact form with name, phone, message fields. Social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn) present

terms_page.details: /terms page loads with accordion sections, CBI badge, company logo

usdt_section.details: USDT image (3D render) displaying correctly instead of 3D model

dark_light_mode.details: Theme toggle changes background from rgb(15,23,42) to rgb(248,250,252)

section_contrast.details: 7 sections with gradient backgrounds providing visual contrast

cta_buttons.details: Booking and Transfers CTA buttons present and clickable

bug_fixed.issue: logo_color.svg was broken - SVG file contained reference to local Windows path instead of actual SVG content
bug_fixed.fix: Changed logoColor to use logo_black.svg for light mode display
bug_fixed.root_cause: The uploaded logo_color.svg file was incorrectly exported - it contained an xlink:href to a local file path (C:\Users\mouad\Downloads\...) instead of embedded SVG paths

api_tests_passed: GET /api/rates - returns list of exchange rates
